--1. What is the total sales revenue generated by each store?

	SELECT 
    	s.Store_ID AS [Store ID],
    	s.Store_Name AS [Store Name],
    FORMAT(SUM(sa.Units * p.Product_Price), 'C', 'en-US') AS [Total Sales Revenue]
	FROM dbo.sales AS sa
	JOIN dbo.stores AS s
	    ON sa.Store_ID = s.Store_ID
	JOIN dbo.products AS p
    	ON sa.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
	GROUP BY 
    	s.Store_ID, 
    	s.Store_Name
	ORDER BY 
   		SUM(sa.Units * p.Product_Price) DESC;

![](https://i.imgur.com/Pke3PNJ.png)

--2. Top-selling products by units sold

	SELECT 
 		p.Product_ID AS [Product ID],
       	p.Product_Name AS [Product Name],
       	SUM(s.Units) AS [Total Units Sold]
	FROM dbo.sales s
	JOIN dbo.products p ON s.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
	GROUP BY p.Product_ID, p.Product_Name
	ORDER BY SUM(s.Units) DESC;

![](https://i.imgur.com/QZQyykq.png)

--3. Sales performance by product category

	SELECT 
 		p.Product_Category AS [Product Category],
       '$ ' + CAST(SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price) AS VARCHAR(20)) AS [Total Sales Revenue]
	FROM dbo.sales s
	JOIN dbo.products p ON s.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
	GROUP BY p.Product_Category
	ORDER BY SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price) DESC;
 
![](https://i.imgur.com/L0cP5YF.png)

--4. Inventory levels

	SELECT 
 		st.Store_ID AS [Store ID],
       	st.Store_Name AS [Store Name],
       	p.Product_ID AS [Product ID],
       	p.Product_Name AS [Product Name],
       	i.Stock_On_Hand AS [Stock_On_Hand]
	FROM dbo.inventory i
	JOIN dbo.stores st ON i.Store_ID = st.Store_ID
	JOIN dbo.products p ON i.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
	ORDER BY st.Store_ID, p.Product_ID;

![](https://i.imgur.com/yi5eeyo.png)

--5. Monthly sales trends 

	SELECT 
 		st.Store_ID AS [Store ID],
       	st.Store_Name AS [Store Name],
       	YEAR(s.Date) AS [Year],
       	MONTH(s.Date) AS [Month Number],
       	DATENAME(MONTH, s.Date) AS [Month Name],
       	SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price) AS [Total Sales Revenue]
	FROM dbo.sales s
	JOIN dbo.stores st ON s.Store_ID = st.Store_ID
	JOIN dbo.products p ON s.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
	GROUP BY st.Store_ID, st.Store_Name, YEAR(s.Date), MONTH(s.Date), DATENAME(MONTH, s.Date)
	ORDER BY st.Store_ID, [Year], [Month Number];

![](https://i.imgur.com/LjctvoL.png)

--6. Highest and lowest performing stores

	WITH Sales_Performance AS (
    	SELECT 
	 		st.Store_ID AS [Store ID],
           	st.Store_Name AS [Store Name],
           	SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price) AS [Total Sales Revenue]
    	FROM dbo.sales s
    	JOIN dbo.stores st ON s.Store_ID = st.Store_ID
    	JOIN dbo.products p ON s.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
    	GROUP BY st.Store_ID, st.Store_Name
	)
	SELECT 
 		sp.[Store ID],
       	sp.[Store Name],
       	sp.[Total Sales Revenue],
		CASE
           WHEN sp.[Total Sales Revenue] = (SELECT MAX([Total Sales Revenue]) FROM Sales_Performance) THEN 'Highest'
           WHEN sp.[Total Sales Revenue] = (SELECT MIN([Total Sales Revenue]) FROM Sales_Performance) THEN 'Lowest'
       	END AS [Performance]
	FROM Sales_Performance sp
	WHERE sp.[Total Sales Revenue] = (SELECT MAX([Total Sales Revenue]) FROM Sales_Performance)
   	OR sp.[Total Sales Revenue] = (SELECT MIN([Total Sales Revenue]) FROM Sales_Performance);

![](https://i.imgur.com/zQs9Ea7.png)

--7. Profit margin per product

	SELECT 
 		Product_ID AS [Product ID],
       	Product_Name AS [Product Name],
       	Product_Cost AS [Cost Price],
       	Product_Price AS [Selling Price],
       	CAST(ROUND(((Product_Price - Product_Cost) / Product_Price) * 100, 2) AS VARCHAR) + ' %' AS [Profit Margin (%)]
	FROM dbo.products;

 ![](https://i.imgur.com/WRMVFS9.png)

--8. Sales by city

	SELECT 
 		st.Store_City AS [City],
   		'$ ' + CAST(SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price) AS VARCHAR(20)) AS [Total Sales Revenue]
	FROM dbo.sales s
	JOIN dbo.stores st ON s.Store_ID = st.Store_ID
	JOIN dbo.products p ON s.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
	GROUP BY st.Store_City
	ORDER BY SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price) DESC;

 ![](https://i.imgur.com/waNLX6b.png)

--9. Out of stock products

	SELECT 
 		st.Store_Name AS [Store Name],
       	p.Product_Name AS [Product Name],
       	CASE WHEN i.Stock_On_Hand = 0 THEN 'Out Of Stock' ELSE 'Available' END AS [Stock Status]
	FROM dbo.inventory i
		JOIN dbo.stores st ON i.Store_ID = st.Store_ID
		JOIN dbo.products p ON i.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
	WHERE i.Stock_On_Hand = 0;

 ![](https://i.imgur.com/uncoCV6.png)

--10. Sales by date

	SELECT 
		s.Date AS [Sale Date],
       	SUM(s.Units) AS [Total Units Sold],
       	SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price) AS [Total Sales Revenue]
	FROM dbo.sales s
	JOIN dbo.products p ON s.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
	GROUP BY s.Date
	ORDER BY s.Date;

 ![](https://i.imgur.com/feGy3QF.png)

--11. Average cost by category

	SELECT
		p.Product_Category AS [Product Category],
       	'$ ' + CAST(ROUND(AVG(p.Product_Cost), 2) AS VARCHAR(10)) AS [Average Cost]
	FROM dbo.products p
	GROUP BY p.Product_Category
	ORDER BY AVG(p.Product_Cost) DESC;
 
![](https://i.imgur.com/Zq2FjvU.png)

--12. Total sales revenue and growth
    
	SELECT
		FORMAT(s.Date, 'yyyy-MM') AS [Month],
       	SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price) AS [Total Sales Revenue],
       	LAG(SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price)) OVER (ORDER BY FORMAT(s.Date, 'yyyy-MM')) AS [Previous Month Sales],
       	CAST(ROUND((SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price) - LAG(SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price)) OVER (ORDER BY FORMAT(s.Date, 'yyyy-MM'))) 
                 / NULLIF(LAG(SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price)) OVER (ORDER BY FORMAT(s.Date, 'yyyy-MM')),0) * 100, 2) AS VARCHAR) + ' %' AS [Sales Growth (%)]
	FROM dbo.sales s
	JOIN dbo.products p ON s.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
	GROUP BY FORMAT(s.Date, 'yyyy-MM')
	ORDER BY [Month];
 
![](https://i.imgur.com/wuZNJRv.png)

--13. Store open date vs sales

	SELECT 
 		st.Store_Open_Date AS [Store Open Date],
       	st.Store_Name AS [Store Name],
       	YEAR(st.Store_Open_Date) AS [Open Year],
       	SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price) AS [Total Sales Revenue]
	FROM dbo.sales s
	JOIN dbo.stores st ON s.Store_ID = st.Store_ID
	JOIN dbo.products p ON s.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
	GROUP BY st.Store_Open_Date, st.Store_Name
	ORDER BY [Open Year], [Total Sales Revenue] DESC;

![](https://i.imgur.com/XHSyWhn.png)

--14. Percentage of total sales by store

	SELECT st.Store_Name AS [Store Name],
       SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price) AS [Store Sales],
       ROUND(SUM(s.Units * p.Product_Price) * 100 / 
             (SELECT SUM(s2.Units * p2.Product_Price)
              FROM dbo.sales s2
              JOIN dbo.products p2 ON s2.Product_ID = p2.Product_ID), 2) AS [Sales Percentage (%)]
	FROM dbo.sales s
	JOIN dbo.stores st 
 		ON s.Store_ID = st.Store_ID
	JOIN dbo.products p 
 		ON s.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
	GROUP BY st.Store_Name
	ORDER BY [Sales Percentage (%)] DESC;

![](https://i.imgur.com/Bg4Ptlc.png)

--15. Compare sales vs current stock levels

	SELECT 
 		p.Product_Name AS [Product Name],
       	SUM(s.Units) AS [Total Units Sold],
       	i.Stock_On_Hand AS [Current Stock Level],
       	(i.Stock_On_Hand - SUM(s.Units)) AS [Stock After Sales]
	FROM dbo.sales s
	JOIN dbo.products p 
 		ON s.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
	JOIN dbo.inventory i 
 		ON p.Product_ID = i.Product_ID
	GROUP BY p.Product_Name, i.Stock_On_Hand
	ORDER BY [Stock After Sales] ASC;

 ![](https://i.imgur.com/j6DPbMD.png)
